line_text: you, Mr. Higgins, for your leadership to prevent this unprecedented shift of wealth from working people to millionaires, billionaires, and corporations. Let us be clear that this pay more for less bill is not a health care bill. It is a tax bill that gives $600 billion in tax cuts to the wealthiest. And it's paid for on the backs of poor and middle class households. In fact, the one basic principle that seems to be  Consistent in this bill is that the richer you are, the bigger your tax cut. For instance, the top  4% of income earners who earn more than $300  million a year will get a total tax break of $275 million, or about $200,000 a year each. Meanwhile, working families see their benefits cut and their premiums rise. Madam Chairman, this is America. We don't begrudge people good fortune, but this bill is pure greed. The rich get richer while 24 million people are stripped of health care. That is simply not right. I yield back.
quote: It is a tax bill that gives $600 billion in tax cuts to the wealthiest. And it's paid for on the backs of poor and middle class households.
rationale: Argued the instrument on the floor is a tax vehicle rather than a coverage vehicle, put a dollar size on the tax side ($600 billion), named the households that finance it, and later named the coverage consequence (24 million stripped of health care) and the household-level effect (benefits cut, premiums rise). MECHANISM (the pay-for stated in the right direction: the tax reduction is financed out of coverage and household budgets) + ANCHOR (two live figures on a bill actually before the committee) + LOSER (poor and middle class households, working families, and a counted 24 million). Short of the +50 rung because no payer statute, program or authority is named -- no exclusion, no premium tax credit, no FMAP, no CMS -- so the coverage machinery is asserted at the level of the bill's effect and not of the payment machine. Rubric example: the enhanced-PTC sunset or FMAP 90/10; subject's instance: the bill's own tax title set against the coverage loss it finances.

rationale: Stated a distributional rule for the tax title -- the richer you are, the bigger your tax cut -- and then worked it as an example: a named earner band, an aggregate tax break, and a per-taxpayer average derived from that aggregate, with the offset named as cuts falling on poor and middle class households. MECHANISM (a legislated transfer with a stated pay-for rather than an unfinanced cut) + ANCHOR ($600 billion, a top earner band, $275 million, about $200,000 each) + LOSER (named). Held below the +50 rung on two legs: only statutory incidence is offered -- who receives the cut on the form -- with no economic incidence, no elasticity and no closing path named; and the figures as transcribed do not reconcile with each other ($275 million spread across a top 4% band does not yield about $200,000 each), which limits the anchor without being an inversion of any instrument.

rationale: Asserted that the legislation moves wealth upward from working people to millionaires, billionaires and corporations, and offered as the explanation of why the rule is written that way that the bill 'is pure greed'. The loser is named and the transfer carries a dollar figure, which is more than naming the phenomenon; but the account of HOW the rule came to be written is a motive attributed to the bill rather than any channel -- no lobbying path, no proximity to rule-making, no concentrated-benefit-diffuse-cost engine, no structural remedy -- which is the personality theory this sub area's harmful_inversion names ('it is rigged because villains are villains'). Substitution test run in the mirror direction: the same sentence with the beneficiary class reversed reads identically and scores identically, so the number is on the missing channel and not on the prescription.

rationale: Carried one argument from claim to stop inside a one-minute floor statement: reclassified the instrument, sized it, named who pays for it, stated the governing principle in a sentence a listener can repeat ('the richer you are, the bigger your tax cut'), gave a worked instance with figures, and closed on a single committing line before yielding back. Ordered steps with a stop; plain language with no jargon and no talking down; the definition placed before the applause line rather than after it. MECHANISM (the explanation is sequenced, not asserted) + ANCHOR (numbers carried with units into a live committee room). Below the +50 rung because no figure is given a source or a date and the worked example's numbers do not hold together as spoken, so the listener cannot keep them. Delivery only -- whether the claims are right is scored in the knowledge areas, not here.

rationale: Put the hard charge on the table without a euphemism and without a slur, and drew a distinction that does work: separated wealth itself, which is explicitly not begrudged, from the instrument, so the charge lands on the bill and the people named in the previous sentences stay people. Closed on a holdable sentence ('That is simply not right') rather than a fog. MECHANISM (the charge is aimed at a named vehicle rather than at a class of persons) + FALSIFIER in weak form (a concession stated against the speaker's own rhetorical interest). Short of the top because the other side's case is never stated in words its holders could use, and the passage ends on applause lines rather than on the distinction. Rubric example: a hard charge aimed at a vote or a named act; subject's instance: the bill under markup, with the wealthy left as people who have good fortune.
